pack.name: AI Recipes: Audio
pack.description: Songs composed from AI-written lyrics, a two-step debate podcast, and narrated voiceover shorts — preset voices only.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Podcast Episode
templates.description: Renders the oldest unrendered podcast script to an episode: Claude casts a preset voice per speaker and writes show notes, then every line is spoken with Gemini or ElevenLabs text-to-speech. Exits cleanly when there's nothing to render.

parameters.help: Claude model alias for the run.

parameters.help: auto uses GEMINI_API_KEY if set, else ELEVENLABS_API_KEY. Preset voices only.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Podcast Script
templates.description: Claude writes a 1,500–3,000-word AI-vs-AI debate podcast episode as a speaker-labelled transcript, with a fictional cast (or your own recurring cast cards) and an optional topic queue, plus a square cover. Pair it with the Podcast Episode recipe.

templates.name: AI Recipe: Song
templates.description: Claude writes an original song in the type you choose — news song, rock, country, rap, psychedelic, folk, jazz and more, most with a comedy twin — as lyrics plus an ElevenLabs composition plan, then the runner renders the MP3 and a square cover. Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY; each run spends music credits.
